news.title: Italy: Mancini calls up nine newcomers after World Cup 2026 failure
news.lede: In his first squad since returning to lead Italy, Roberto Mancini has called up nine uncapped players in a group of 34 to launch the Nations League. Roberto Mancini has called up nine uncapped players in a squad of 34 for Italy’s first four matches in the Nations League. This list, published on Friday, September 18, marks the coach’s first selection since returning to lead the Azzurri following the team’s failure to qualify for the 2026 World Cup. Massimo Pessina, Daniele Ghilardi, Michael Kayode, Eddy Kouadio, Issa Doumbia, Alessandro Romano, Sebastiano Esposito, Antonio Vergara, and Mohamed Alì Zoma are set to make their debut in the senior national team.

news.title: Italy and Inter icon Sandro Mazzola passes away aged 83 as world of football pays tribute to legendary playmaker
news.lede: Italian football is mourning the loss of Sandro Mazzola, who has passed away at the age of 83 following an illness. The legendary attacking midfielder spent his entire playing career at Inter and remains one of the most decorated figures in the history of the sport. Italian football has lost one of its greatest ever players after Mazzola passed away on Saturday at the age of 83 following an illness. The iconic attacking midfielder spent his entire career with Inter, etching his name into football folklore.

news.title: This college football team just adopted Norway's World Cup Viking Row
news.lede: Norway's Viking Row was one of the most viral fan traditions of the 2026 World Cup. Now, two months later, it has officially made its way into American college football. The University of Minnesota debuted its own version of the synchronized rowing chant at its season opener at Huntington Bank Stadium, with the student section sitting in rows and mimicking the same exaggerated rowing motion that Norwegian fans made famous this summer. Former Gophers linebacker Kamal Martin led the chant before kickoff, keeping one of the World Cup's biggest fan traditions going long after the tournament ended.

news.title: From Son-Lee clash to World Cup collapse, can Moreno get Warriors back on track?
news.lede: A lack of camaraderie — and even a tinge of hostility — paired with a languid mentality brought Korean football to its lowest point in years. Can an interim gaffer fix that? Korean football is coming off one of its most demoralizing summers since rising to the top of the sport in Asia. However, the dismal World Cup result — failing to make the knockout round — was a by-product of a bigger issue: a loss of camaraderie and fighting spirit among the players.

news.title: Panama name 14 World Cuppers for India friendly
news.lede: Panaji: At 44, Panama is the lowest-ranked team that India will face during the FIFA international match window, but Khalid Jamil’s team has a fierce battle on its hand as Los Canaleros will arrive here with 14 players who were part of the squad for the FIFA World Cup 2026. Panama were placed in a challenging World Cup group, which included England, Croatia and Ghana. Central America’s only representatives were competitive but suffered narrow losses against Croatia and Ghana, and ended their campaign with a 2-0 loss against England as Jude Bellingham and Harry Kane clinched top spot for the Three Lions.After ending without a point at the World Cup, coach Thomas Christiansen has now started rebuilding the squad.

news.title: Italy Women's U20 Beat South Korea 3-1 to Reach World Cup Semi-Finals
news.lede: A historic day for the Italy Women's Under-20 team. The national side reached a historic semi-final at the U20 World Cup, overcoming South Korea with a clear 3-1 victory in Sosnowiec, Poland. Appiah's brace proved decisive, with goals in the 16th and 48th minutes. Fadda then sealed the win in the 63rd minute with a superb long-range strike, rendering Haeun's 42nd-minute goal for South Korea a mere consolation.

news.title: No. 20 Tigers celebrate Memorial Stadium 100th anniversary
news.lede: Mizzou football (2-0, 0-0 SEC) is back at home this week to host Troy (2-0, 0-0 SBC) for the Memorial Stadium 100th anniversary game at 6 p.m. The 20th-ranked team will celebrate the 100th anniversary of Memorial Stadium by wearing special throwback uniforms on the field, according to Mizzou Athletics. The uniforms will bring back Tiger nostalgia, combining elements from several areas of Mizzou football including the 1920's-style "M' on the jersey, 1970's-inspired sleeve stripes and a narrow Block M with a gray facemask reminiscent of the helmet design introduced in 1971, according to Mizzou Athletics. The helmets front bumper will display the six Columns of Francis Quadrangle, while the pants will represent the historic shade of gold worn by the Tigers through the 20th century, according to Mizzou Athletics.
